fields.description: Weekly issue featuring commentary and local news centered on Miami Beach politics and the upcoming municipal election, including discussion of candidates and city council dynamics. Includes extensive coverage and advertising related to South Florida horse racing (Tropical Park and Hialeah Park) with tips and selections, along with society/entertainment items and promotions for venues, restaurants, and nightclubs. Also contains a piece on NRA compliance and labor practices in automobile delivery caravans.
